questions.prompt: Do you prefer hot weather or cold weather?
questions.sampleA1: I like cold. Cold is good. Hot is bad.
questions.sampleA2: I like cold weather. Because I can wear a jacket. But hot weather is not good.
questions.sampleB1: I prefer cold weather. I like to wear jackets and hats. For example, I like winter sports. However, some people like hot weather. It depends on the person.
questions.sampleB2: To be honest, I'm much more of a cold-weather person. I can't stand the summer heat — it wears me out and leaves me feeling sluggish all day. When it's chilly, though, I feel far more alive. I suppose there's nothing better than bundling up in a cosy jumper with a hot drink. Winter's right up my street, honestly.
questions.uzSampleA1: Menga sovuq yoqadi. Sovuq yaxshi. Issiq yomon.
questions.uzSampleA2: Menga sovuq ob-havo yoqadi. Chunki men kurtka kiyishim mumkin. Lekin issiq ob-havo yaxshi emas.
questions.uzSampleB1: Men sovuq ob-havoni afzal ko'raman. Menga kurtkalar va shapkalar kiyish yoqadi. Masalan, menga qishki sport turlari yoqadi. Biroq, ba'zi odamlarga issiq ob-havo yoqadi. Bu odamga bog'liq.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Men aniqrog'i sovuq ob-havoni afzal ko'raman. Menimcha, havo salqinroq bo'lganda ancha unumliroqman.
Qolaversa, chang'i va snoubord kabi qishki sport turlarini yoqtiraman, shuning uchun sovuq oylarni kutishga moyilman.
Albatta, har kimning o'z xohishlari bor, lekin men issiqni bardosh berishga qiyin deb bilaman.

vocabulary.title: Do you...
idioms: right up my alley - "men uchun aynan mos"
not my cup of tea - "mening didimga to'g'ri kelmaydi"

questions.sampleAnswer:
Personally, I lean towards colder weather. I find the oppressive heat of summer to be quite draining, and it often leaves me feeling sluggish and unproductive. Moreover, the need for constant air conditioning can take its toll on the environment.

Cold weather, on the other hand, is invigorating. I enjoy the crispness in the air, the opportunity to bundle up in cozy sweaters, and the way a fresh snowfall transforms the landscape. It's right up my alley. Plus, activities like skiing and snowboarding are a great way to blow off steam and enjoy the outdoors.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Shaxsan men sovuq ob-havoga moyilman. Yozning bosim o'tkazuvchi issig'i meni juda charchatadi va ko'pincha dangasa va unumsiz his qilaman. Bundan tashqari, doimiy ravishda konditsionerga bo'lgan ehtiyoj atrof-muhitga o'z ta'sirini o'tkazishi mumkin.

Sovuq ob-havo esa, aksincha, tetiklantiradi. Menga havoning tiniqligi, qulay sviterlarga o'ranish imkoniyati va yangi yog'gan qorning manzarani o'zgartirishi yoqadi. Bu aynan men xohlagan narsa. Qolaversa, chang'i va snoubord kabi mashg'ulotlar dam olish va tabiatdan bahra olishning ajoyib usuli hisoblanadi.

questions.prompt: Can you live without technology for a day?
questions.sampleA1: No, I can't. I need my phone. My phone is important.
questions.sampleA2: I don't know. Maybe I can. But it will be hard. Because I use my phone every day.
questions.sampleB1: I think it would be difficult. I use technology for many things. For example, I use my phone for communication. However, maybe I could read a book instead. It would be a challenge.
questions.sampleB2: Honestly, it would be a real challenge, but I reckon I could pull it off for one day. The thing is, I'm so used to checking my phone every five minutes. Still, I'd probably fall back on older habits — reading a paperback or going for a long walk. It might even be a bit of a breath of fresh air.
questions.uzSampleA1: Yo'q, men qila olmayman. Menga telefonim kerak. Mening telefonim muhim.
questions.uzSampleA2: Bilmadim. Balki men qila olarmikanman. Lekin bu qiyin bo'ladi. Chunki men har kuni telefonimdan foydalanaman.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Menimcha, bu qiyin bo'lardi. Men texnologiyadan ko'p narsalar uchun foydalanaman.
Masalan, men telefonimdan aloqa uchun foydalanaman.
Biroq, balki men buning o'rniga kitob o'qishim mumkin. Bu bir sinov bo'lardi.
questions.uzSampleB2: Bu, albatta, qiyinchilik tug'diradi, lekin menimcha, bir kun uddalay olaman. Telefon va kompyuterimdan uzilish uchun ongli ravishda harakat qilishim kerak bo'ladi. Buning o'rniga, kitob o'qishga, sayr qilishga yoki do'stlar bilan yuzma-yuz uchrashishga vaqt ajratishim mumkin. Oxir-oqibat, bu hatto vaqtinchalik bo'lsa ham, tetiklantiruvchi tajriba bo'lishi mumkin.

questions.sampleAnswer:
That's a challenging question. I think it depends on what you mean by 'live.' Could I survive? Probably, yes. Could I maintain my current lifestyle and level of productivity? Almost certainly not. Technology is so intertwined with every aspect of my life, from communication and work to entertainment and information gathering, that going cold turkey would be incredibly disruptive.

I suppose I could fall back on older methods – writing letters instead of emails, reading physical books instead of online articles, and relying on maps instead of GPS. However, it would be a significant adjustment and would undoubtedly slow me down. It's a tall order, but perhaps a worthwhile experiment in disconnecting from the digital world.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Bu qiyin savol. Menimcha, bu "yashash" deganda nimani nazarda tutishingizga bog'liq. Omon qola olamanmi? Ehtimol, ha. Hozirgi turmush tarzimi va unumdorlik darajamni saqlab qola olamanmi? Deyarli aniq emas. Texnologiya mening hayotimning har bir jabhasiga, aloqa va ishdan tortib, ko'ngilochar va ma'lumot to'plashgacha shunchalik chambarchas bog'langanki, birdaniga voz kechish juda buzuvchi bo'ladi.

O'ylaymanki, men eski usullarga qaytishim mumkin - elektron pochta o'rniga xatlar yozish, onlayn maqolalar o'rniga jismoniy kitoblarni o'qish va GPS o'rniga xaritalarga tayanish. Biroq, bu sezilarli o'zgarish bo'ladi va, shubhasiz, meni sekinlashtiradi. Bu juda qiyin vazifa, lekin raqamli dunyodan uzilish bo'yicha arzirli tajriba bo'lishi mumkin.

questions.prompt: Do you prefer home-cooked food or restaurant food?
questions.sampleA1: I like home food. It is good. I like restaurant food too.
questions.sampleA2: I like home food because it is healthy. But restaurant food is tasty too. So I like both.
questions.sampleB1: I like both home-cooked food and restaurant food. Home-cooked food is usually healthier. For example, my mother cooks very healthy food. However, restaurant food can be more exciting. It depends on what I want.
questions.sampleB2: I'd say I lean towards home-cooked food, to be honest. There's something really comforting about a home-made meal — it's made with love and it's usually far healthier. That said, I do enjoy eating out now and then, mainly to try out new cuisines I'd never cook myself. I suppose it boils down to the mood I'm in.
questions.uzSampleA1: Men uyda tayyorlangan ovqatni yaxshi ko'raman. U yaxshi. Men restoran ovqatini ham yaxshi ko'raman.
questions.uzSampleA2: Men uyda tayyorlangan ovqatni yaxshi ko'raman, chunki u foydali. Lekin restorandagi ovqat ham mazali. Shuning uchun ikkalasini ham yaxshi ko'raman.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Men uyda tayyorlangan ovqatni ham, restorandagi ovqatni ham yaxshi ko'raman. Uyda tayyorlangan ovqat odatda sog'lomroq bo'ladi.
Masalan, onam juda sog'lom ovqat pishiradi.
Biroq, restorandagi ovqat yanada qiziqarliroq bo'lishi mumkin. Bu men nimani xohlashimga bog'liq.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Men uyda tayyorlangan ovqatni ham, restorandagi ovqatni ham qadrlayman, garchi uyda tayyorlangan taomlarga biroz ko'proq moyil bo'lishim mumkin. Sevgi bilan tayyorlangan tanish taomda nimadir taskin beruvchi narsa bor.
Boshqa tomondan, restoranlar odatda o'zim tayyorlamaydigan yangi va hayajonli oshxonalarni tatib ko'rish imkoniyatini beradi.
Oxir oqibat, bu vaziyatga va kayfiyatimga bog'liq, lekin men ikkalasini ham turli sabablarga ko'ra qadrlayman.

vocabulary.title: Do you prefer...
idioms: the best of both worlds - "ikkala dunyoning eng yaxshisi"

questions.sampleAnswer:
That's a tough one! Generally speaking, I appreciate both for different reasons. Home-cooked food holds a special place in my heart because it's often associated with comfort, tradition, and the love that goes into preparing it. There's no place like home, and that certainly extends to the kitchen.

However, restaurant food offers a unique culinary experience. It allows me to explore new flavors, try different cuisines, and enjoy the convenience of not having to cook or clean up. It's a nice treat every now and then. It boils down to the occasion and my mood. If I'm seeking comfort and familiarity, I'll opt for home-cooked meals. If I'm feeling adventurous and want to try something new, I'll head to a restaurant.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Bu qiyin savol! Umuman olganda, men ikkalasini ham turli sabablarga ko'ra qadrlayman. Uyda tayyorlangan ovqat mening qalbimda alohida o'ringa ega, chunki u ko'pincha qulaylik, an'ana va uni tayyorlashga sarflangan mehr bilan bog'liq. "O'z uyim - o'lan to'shagim" deganlaridek, bu, albatta, oshxonaga ham tegishli.

Biroq, restoran ovqati o'ziga xos kulinar tajribani taqdim etadi. Bu menga yangi ta'mlarni o'rganish, turli xil oshxonalarni sinab ko'rish va ovqat pishirish yoki tozalash zarurati bo'lmagan qulaylikdan bahramand bo'lish imkonini beradi. Vaqti-vaqti bilan bu yaxshi bir hordiq chiqarishdir. Hammasi vaziyatga va kayfiyatimga bog'liq. Agar men qulaylik va tanishlikni qidirsam, uyda tayyorlangan ovqatlarni tanlayman. Agar men sarguzashtni his qilsam va yangi narsalarni sinab ko'rmoqchi bo'lsam, restoranga boraman.

questions.prompt: Describe the different types of homes shown in the photos.
questions.sampleA1: One is big. One is small. One is in the city. One is in the forest.
questions.sampleA2: The first house is big and tall. It is in the city. But the second house is small and in the forest.
questions.sampleB1: The first photo shows a skyscraper in a city. It is very tall and modern. For example, it might have many offices. The second photo shows a small house in the forest. However, it looks very peaceful and quiet.
questions.sampleB2: So, both of these pictures depict the same tranquil scene: a charming wooden cabin nestled deep within an autumn forest. The cabin itself looks rustic and inviting, with a mossy roof and smoke rising from its chimney, suggesting warmth inside. There’s firewood stacked neatly on the porch, and a narrow path winds its way through the trees to the entrance. The vibrant colours of the leaves, ranging from green to golden orange, really set the mood, making it feel like a perfect peaceful escape from city life. It’s definitely a picture of serene natural beauty.

questions.uzSampleA2: Birinchi uy katta va baland. U shaharda joylashgan. Lekin ikkinchi uy kichkina va o'rmonda.
questions.uzSampleB1: Birinchi suratda shahardagi osmono'par bino ko'rsatilgan. U juda baland va zamonaviy. Masalan, unda ko'plab ofislar bo'lishi mumkin. Ikkinchi suratda o'rmondagi kichik uy ko'rsatilgan. Biroq, u juda tinch va sokin ko'rinadi.
questions.uzSampleB2: Birinchi rasmda zamonaviy osmono'par bino ko'rsatilgan, u, albatta, gavjum shahar muhitida joylashgan. Bu shahar hayoti va zamonaviy arxitekturaning ramzi. Aksincha, ikkinchi rasmda kichik, qishloq uy tasvirlangan bo'lib, u tabiiy muhitda, ehtimol o'rmonda yoki qishloqda joylashgan. Bu yanada sodda va tinch hayot tarzini ifodalaydi. Ikkalasining o'rtasidagi farq juda yaqqol ko'rinadi.

questions.sampleAnswer:
Okay, in the first photo, we see a towering skyscraper, which is clearly located in a bustling city center. The building is made of glass and steel, and it exudes modernity and sophistication. Presumably, it houses offices, apartments, or a combination of both. It's a real concrete jungle.

In contrast, the second photo depicts a small, wooden house nestled in a serene forest or village. It's quite a contrast. The house is surrounded by lush greenery, and it emanates a sense of peace and tranquility. Undoubtedly, this is a place where one can escape the hustle and bustle of city life and get back to nature. It just goes to show how differently people live.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Xo'sh, birinchi suratda biz baland osmono'par binoni ko'rib turibmiz, u aniq gavjum shahar markazida joylashgan. Bino shisha va po'latdan yasalgan bo'lib, u zamonaviylik va nafosatni taratadi. Ehtimol, u ofislar, kvartiralar yoki ikkalasining kombinatsiyasidan iboratdir. Bu haqiqiy beton o'rmon.

Aksincha, ikkinchi suratda sokin o'rmon yoki qishloqda joylashgan kichik, yog'och uy tasvirlangan. Bu juda katta farq. Uy serhosil ko'katlar bilan o'ralgan va u tinchlik va osoyishtalik hissini uyg'otadi. Shubhasiz, bu shahar hayotining shovqinidan qochib, tabiatga qaytish mumkin bo'lgan joy. Bu odamlarning qanchalik turli xil yashashini ko'rsatadi.

questions.prompt: What are the benefits of living in a quiet house close to nature?
questions.sampleA1: Quiet house good. Nature is nice. I like trees.
questions.sampleA2: I like the quiet house. It is near nature. I can relax there.
questions.sampleB1: Living in a quiet house is good. It is near nature. For example, you can hear birds. You can also relax. However, it might be far from the city. This can be a problem.
questions.sampleB2: Well, the biggest benefit is the peace and quiet, I'd say. You can finally switch off and unwind after a long day, away from all the traffic and noise. On top of that, you've got fresh air and green space right on your doorstep, which is great for clearing your head. The thing is, it really does work wonders for your mental health.
questions.uzSampleA1: Tinch uy yaxshi. Tabiat chiroyli. Daraxtlar menga yoqadi.
questions.uzSampleA2: Menga tinch uy yoqadi. U tabiatga yaqin. Men u yerda dam olishim mumkin.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Tinch uyda yashash yaxshi. U tabiatga yaqin.
Masalan, siz qushlarning ovozini eshitishingiz mumkin. Siz ham dam olishingiz mumkin.
Biroq, u shahardan uzoqda bo'lishi mumkin. Bu muammo bo'lishi mumkin.
questions.uzSampleB2: Tabiatga yaqin, tinch uyda yashashning bir qancha afzalliklari bor. Shaharga nisbatan ancha tinch va xotirjam bo'ladi. Siz shovqin va stressdan qutulishingiz mumkin. Bundan tashqari, ochiq havoda mashg'ulotlar bilan shug'ullanish imkoniyati oson bo'ladi. Boshqa tomondan, agar siz tez-tez shaharga borishingiz kerak bo'lsa, noqulay bo'lishi mumkin.

questions.sampleAnswer:
Living in a quiet house close to nature offers a world of benefits that cater to both physical and mental well-being. The most obvious is the reduced stress levels; the absence of urban noise pollution allows for a much more relaxed atmosphere where you can unwind and recharge. This tranquility directly contributes to improved sleep quality, which, in turn, enhances cognitive function and overall mood.

Beyond the psychological advantages, being close to nature encourages a more active lifestyle. Hiking, gardening, or simply taking a walk in the woods become readily accessible, promoting physical fitness and a stronger connection with the environment. Furthermore, the cleaner air quality is a significant boon for respiratory health. All in all, a quiet house nestled in nature offers a breath of fresh air, fostering a healthier and more balanced existence.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Tabiatga yaqin, sokin uyda yashash jismoniy va ruhiy farovonlikni ta'minlaydigan ko'plab afzalliklarni taqdim etadi. Eng aniq afzalligi - stress darajasining pasayishi; shahar shovqinining yo'qligi dam olish va kuch yig'ish imkonini beradigan ancha xotirjam muhitni yaratadi. Bu osoyishtalik bevosita uyqu sifatini yaxshilashga yordam beradi, bu esa o'z navbatida kognitiv funktsiyani va umumiy kayfiyatni yaxshilaydi.

Psixologik afzalliklardan tashqari, tabiatga yaqin bo'lish yanada faol hayot tarzini rag'batlantiradi. Piyoda yurish, bog'dorchilik yoki shunchaki o'rmonda sayr qilish oson bo'ladi, bu jismoniy tayyorgarlikni va atrof-muhit bilan kuchliroq aloqani rivojlantiradi. Bundan tashqari, toza havo sifati nafas olish salomatligi uchun muhim foydadir. Umuman olganda, tabiat qo'ynidagi sokin uy sog'lom va muvozanatli hayotni ta'minlab, yangi nafas olib keladi.

questions.prompt: Why do some people prefer living in a busy city with many facilities?
questions.sampleA1: City is busy. Many shops. I like city.
questions.sampleA2: I like city. It has many shops and restaurants. It is fun.
questions.sampleB1: Some people like the city. It has many things. For example, there are many shops. There are also many restaurants. However, the city can be noisy. It can also be expensive.
questions.sampleB2: I suppose the main draw is convenience. In a big city, everything's at your fingertips — shops, restaurants, cinemas — so you're spoilt for choice. On top of that, cities offer far more job opportunities, which is a real pull for young people trying to get ahead. Sure, it can be noisy and pricey, but for a lot of people that's a price worth paying.

Bundan tashqari, shaharlarda ko'pincha ish imkoniyatlari ko'proq bo'ladi. Boshqa tomondan, shaharlar olomon va qimmat bo'lishi mumkin.

questions.sampleAnswer:
The allure of a busy city, despite its drawbacks, lies primarily in the unparalleled convenience and access it offers. The sheer density of amenities, from diverse culinary experiences to cutting-edge entertainment venues, means that residents are spoiled for choice. Everything is, quite literally, at your doorstep.

Furthermore, cities are often epicenters of professional opportunity, attracting ambitious individuals seeking career advancement and networking possibilities. The concentration of industries and businesses fosters a dynamic and competitive environment, which can be highly stimulating for those driven by success. It's a trade-off: sacrificing tranquility for opportunity, and for many, it's a price worth paying.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Gavjum shahar o'zining kamchiliklariga qaramay, asosan, taqqoslanmas qulaylik va imkoniyatlar taklif etishi bilan o'ziga jalb qiladi. Turli xil oshxona tajribalaridan tortib, eng zamonaviy ko'ngilochar maskanlargacha bo'lgan qulayliklarning zichligi shundan iboratki, aholi tanlash imkoniyatiga ega. Hamma narsa, tom ma'noda, sizning eshigingiz oldida.

Bundan tashqari, shaharlar ko'pincha professional imkoniyatlar markazi bo'lib, martaba o'sishi va aloqa o'rnatish imkoniyatlarini izlayotgan ambitsiyali shaxslarni o'ziga jalb qiladi. Sanoat va biznesning konsentratsiyasi dinamik va raqobatbardosh muhitni yaratadi, bu muvaffaqiyatga intilayotganlar uchun juda rag'batlantiruvchi bo'lishi mumkin. Bu bir kelishuv: xotirjamlikni imkoniyatga almashtirish, va ko'pchilik uchun bu to'lashga arziydigan narx.

questions.prompt: Describe a time you spent a day without using any electronic gadgets.
questions.sampleA1: I turned off phone. I read book. It was good.
questions.sampleA2: I didn't use phone that day. I read a book and played outside. It was fun because I was not on my phone.
questions.sampleB1: One day, I did not use any electronic gadgets. I turned off my phone and computer. I felt strange at first. For example, I didn't know what to do. However, I started reading a book. It was actually very relaxing. Families should have no-screen time because they can talk to each other.
questions.sampleB2: I'd like to tell you about a day I spent completely cut off from all my gadgets. It was a Sunday last winter, and to be honest, I hadn't planned it — my phone simply ran out of battery and my charger had stopped working. At first, I felt this strange pang of anxiety, almost like I was missing out on something. But once I got over that initial panic, I decided to just go with it and see how the day would pan out. I ended up reading a novel I'd been meaning to finish for ages, and I even went for a long walk in the park. The thing is, without constant notifications pulling me in every few seconds, my mind felt so much clearer. I was genuinely more productive — I got through more in that one afternoon than I usually manage in a whole day. It did wonders for my mood, and I slept like a log that night. I suppose stepping away from screens really recharged my batteries. As for families, I honestly think 'no-screen' time is absolutely vital. These days, everyone's glued to their phones at the dinner table, and it's a real shame because you barely talk to each other. Setting aside screen-free time lets families actually reconnect — chatting, playing games, or just catching up on their day. In the long run, it strengthens the bond between parents and children, and it stops kids from becoming completely dependent on devices. All in all, a little digital detox goes a long way.
questions.uzSampleA1: Men telefonni o'chirdim. Men kitob o'qidim. Bu yaxshi edi.
questions.uzSampleA2: Men o'sha kuni telefondan foydalanmadim. Men kitob o'qidim va tashqarida o'ynadim. Menga qiziqarli bo'ldi, chunki men telefonda emas edim.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Bir kuni men hech qanday elektron qurilmalardan foydalanmadim. Men telefonim va kompyuterimni o'chirdim. Dastlab o'zimni g'alati his qildim.
Masalan, nima qilishni bilmasdim. Biroq, men kitob o'qishni boshladim. Bu aslida juda taskin beruvchi edi. Oilalar ekranlarsiz vaqt o'tkazishlari kerak, chunki ular bir-birlari bilan gaplasha olishadi.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Esimda, men hech qanday elektron qurilmalarsiz kun o'tkazganman. Men o'sha kuni "uzilish"ga qaror qildim. Dastlab qiyin bo'ldi, chunki men doim telefonimni tekshirishga o'rganib qolganman. Biroq, men buni juda tetiklantiruvchi deb topdim. Bu menga dam olishga va boshqa narsalarga e'tibor qaratishga yordam berdi.

O'ylaymanki, oilalar bir-birlari bilan "bog'lanish" uchun ekransiz vaqtga ega bo'lishlari muhim. Ular o'yinlar o'ynashlari, gaplashishlari va umumiy tajribalar orqali "yaqinlashishlari" mumkin. Bu ularning munosabatlarini yaxshilashi va ularni baxtliroq qilishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, bu "stress darajasini kamaytirish"ning yaxshi usuli.

bulletPoints: Describe a time you spent a day without using any electronic gadgets.
How did this break affect your mental well-being and productivity?
Why is it important for families to have "no-screen" time in their daily lives?
questions.sampleAnswer:
I remember a particular Saturday when I decided to switch off all my electronic devices – phone, laptop, everything. Initially, I felt a pang of anxiety, a sense of being disconnected from the world. My usual routine involved constantly checking emails and social media, and suddenly, that was gone. I decided to spend the day reading a physical book in my garden.

The break significantly impacted my mental well-being in a positive way. Without the constant notifications and digital distractions, I felt calmer and more present. My productivity, surprisingly, increased. I managed to finish the book and even started sketching, something I hadn't done in years. Essentially, I rediscovered the joy of simple, analog activities. It was like tuning out all the noise and reconnecting with myself.

It's crucial for families to have "no-screen" time because it fosters genuine connection and communication. When everyone is glued to their devices, it's difficult to engage in meaningful conversations or shared activities. Moreover, excessive screen time can lead to sleep problems, eye strain, and even social isolation, especially for children. Absence makes the heart grow fonder, and in this case, absence from screens makes the family bond stronger. Ultimately, regular screen-free time can promote healthier relationships and a more balanced lifestyle for everyone involved.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Esimda, bir shanba kuni men barcha elektron qurilmalarimni – telefon, noutbuk, hamma narsani o'chirib qo'yishga qaror qildim. Dastlab, men xavotirlik hissini, dunyodan uzilib qolgandek tuyg'uni his qildim. Odatdagi kun tartibim doimiy ravishda elektron pochta va ijtimoiy tarmoqlarni tekshirishni o'z ichiga olardi va birdaniga bu yo'qoldi. Men o'sha kunni bog'imda jismoniy kitob o'qish bilan o'tkazishga qaror qildim.

Bu tanaffus mening ruhiy holatimga ijobiy ta'sir ko'rsatdi. Doimiy bildirishnomalar va raqamli chalg'ituvchi omillarsiz, men o'zimni xotirjamroq va hozirgi vaziyatda his qildim. Mening unumdorligim, ajablanarlisi, oshdi. Men kitobni tugatishga muvaffaq bo'ldim va hatto eskiz chizishni boshladim, buni men yillar davomida qilmagan edim. Aslida, men oddiy, analog faoliyatlarning zavqini qayta kashf qildim. Bu shovqinni o'chirish va o'zim bilan qayta bog'lanishga o'xshardi.

Oila a'zolari uchun "ekransiz" vaqtga ega bo'lish juda muhim, chunki bu chinakam aloqa va muloqotni rivojlantiradi. Hamma o'z qurilmalariga yopishib qolganda, mazmunli suhbatlar yoki umumiy tadbirlarda ishtirok etish qiyin. Bundan tashqari, haddan tashqari ekran vaqti uyqu muammolariga, ko'z zo'riqishiga va hatto ijtimoiy izolyatsiyaga, ayniqsa bolalar uchun olib kelishi mumkin. Uzoqlik qadrdon qiladi, va bu holda, ekranlardan uzoqlik oilaviy rishtalarni mustahkamlaydi. Oxir oqibat, muntazam ekransiz vaqt sog'lom munosabatlarni va barcha ishtirokchilar uchun yanada muvozanatli turmush tarzini targ'ib qilishi mumkin.

questions.prompt: AI Should Replace Humans in Dangerous Jobs
questions.sampleA1: AI is good for dangerous jobs. Humans can get hurt. AI is safe.
questions.sampleA2: AI can do dangerous jobs. It can work all day. But people will lose jobs.
questions.sampleB1: AI can replace humans in dangerous jobs. This can reduce injuries. For example, robots can go to space. However, many people will lose their jobs. Also, the machines might not work right.
questions.sampleB2: This is a really thought-provoking topic, and I can honestly see both sides of the argument. On the one hand, there's a strong case for letting AI and robots take over the most dangerous jobs. Think about deep-sea diving, defusing bombs, or working in nuclear plants — these are situations where human lives are genuinely at risk. Machines can carry out these tasks around the clock without getting tired, and if something goes wrong, no one gets hurt. In that sense, it could save countless lives. Firefighters and miners, for instance, put their lives on the line every single day, so handing those risks to a machine makes perfect sense. Having said that, there's a flip side we can't ignore. If AI takes over these roles, thousands of workers could end up unemployed, and many of them rely on those jobs to make ends meet. What's more, machines aren't perfect — they can malfunction, and they simply don't have the human judgement to think on their feet when something unexpected happens. That could be catastrophic in a critical moment. If you ask me, the sensible way forward is a balance rather than a full replacement. I reckon AI should work alongside people, handling the riskiest parts while humans stay in control and make the big decisions. That way, we get the best of both worlds — safer workplaces without throwing people onto the scrapheap. At the end of the day, technology should be there to protect us, not to push us out altogether. After all, robots should be our tools, not our replacements.

vocabulary.title: AI Should - First words of prompt...

for: Increases efficiency in extreme conditions (space, deep sea).
against: Leads to high unemployment for blue-collar workers.
Machines may malfunction in unpredictable ways.
Lack of human judgment in critical moments.

questions.sampleAnswer:
The proposition of using AI to replace humans in dangerous jobs presents a compelling ethical and practical dilemma. On one hand, the potential to drastically reduce workplace injuries and fatalities is undeniable. In hazardous environments like deep-sea exploration, space missions, or handling toxic materials, AI-powered robots can operate tirelessly and precisely, taking on risks that humans simply shouldn't endure. Moreover, these machines can maintain consistent performance levels 24/7, boosting efficiency in demanding sectors.

However, the transition to AI-driven labor raises serious concerns about widespread unemployment, particularly among blue-collar workers who often rely on these jobs for their livelihood. Furthermore, while AI excels in predictable scenarios, its ability to respond to unforeseen circumstances or exercise nuanced judgment remains limited. A machine malfunction in a critical moment could have catastrophic consequences, especially in situations requiring quick thinking and adaptability. It's a double-edged sword; while AI offers immense potential for safety and efficiency, we must proceed with caution and address the socioeconomic implications responsibly. Look before you leap, and ensure that the benefits outweigh the costs.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Sun'iy intellektni xavfli ishlarda insonlar o'rniga qo'yish taklifi jiddiy axloqiy va amaliy dilemmani keltirib chiqaradi. Bir tomondan, ish joyidagi jarohatlar va o'lim holatlarini keskin kamaytirish imkoniyati inkor etib bo'lmaydi. Chuqur dengiz tadqiqotlari, kosmik missiyalar yoki zaharli materiallar bilan ishlash kabi xavfli muhitlarda sun'iy intellektga asoslangan robotlar tinimsiz va aniq ishlay oladi, insonlar toqat qilmasligi kerak bo'lgan xavflarni o'z zimmasiga oladi. Bundan tashqari, bu mashinalar 24/7 barqaror ishlash darajasini saqlab, talab yuqori bo'lgan sohalarda samaradorlikni oshirishi mumkin.

Biroq, sun'iy intellektga asoslangan mehnatga o'tish keng tarqalgan ishsizlik, ayniqsa, ko'pincha shu ishlarga tayangan ishchilar orasida jiddiy xavotirlarni uyg'otadi. Bundan tashqari, sun'iy intellekt bashorat qilinadigan stsenariylarda yaxshi natijalarga erishsa-da, uning kutilmagan holatlarga javob berish yoki nozik hukm chiqarish qobiliyati cheklangan. Muhim paytda mashinaning nosozligi halokatli oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkin, ayniqsa tezkor fikrlash va moslashuvchanlikni talab qiladigan vaziyatlarda. Bu ikki tomonlama qilich; sun'iy intellekt xavfsizlik va samaradorlik uchun ulkan imkoniyatlarni taqdim etsa-da, biz ehtiyotkorlik bilan harakat qilishimiz va ijtimoiy-iqtisodiy oqibatlarni mas'uliyat bilan hal qilishimiz kerak. O'ylamay qadam bosma, va foyda xarajatlardan ustun ekanligiga ishonch hosil qil.
